pages.text: RETURN ends the function right away. It may name a variable of type ERROR to report a problem to the caller.

$(1)FUNCTION sum$(br)  PARAMETER n INTEGER$(br)  RESULT result INTEGER$(br)BEGIN$(br)  IF n = 0 ;$(br)  BEGIN$(br)    RETURN$(br)  END IF$(br)  CALL sum$(br)    PARAMETER n n - 1 ;$(br)    RESULT result result$(br)  ASSIGN result result + n ;$()
This function calls itself. It adds up all numbers from 1 to n.
